card.name: Linking words after bradycardia
card.fires_on: The comma or the words "and" / "or" right after "bradycardia" (or a nearby heart-rate/blood-pressure effect) in lists of heart-conduction effects from drug combinations.

modes.label: "and"/"or" after bradycardia
modes.description: A joining word directly after bradycardia, before AV block or heart block.
modes.example: Additive effects such as bradycardia<< and>> AV block.

modes.label: Comma in effect lists
modes.description: A comma after bradycardia or hypotension in a list of cardiac effects.
modes.example: -blockers. Co-administration of propranolol and diltiazem in patients with cardiac disease has been associated with bradycardia<<,>> hypotension, high-degree heart block

card.writes: Output effect is unclear; it mostly suppresses tokens like hyper and rest, and promotes odd unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining word or comma after "bradycardia", where the next heart problem such as AV block is listed.
